title: Grilled Essentials!
description: A PEAK performance modpack for a minimalistic number of mods while making the most out of them, heavily increasing performance.
body:
**Did you ever want** ~~amazing~~ **_PEAK_ performance without turning down all settings to "potato"?** Well this modpack solves ALL of that! This modpack aims for the most minimilistic Minecraft experience whilst having GREAT balance between performance and quality!

⚠️**Caution!** This modpack is tuned specifically for PC's that support OpenGL 4.5 and up!
